description: The chart is a donut chart comparing the proportions of three categories, "Deceived", "Partially", and "Not Deceived", across two ambiguities, "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)". The chart is divided into six slices, with three categories represented in each of the two rings. The outer ring, representing "Ambiguity 1", has slices labeled "Deceived" (red, 57.9%), "Partially" (yellow, 31.6%), and "Not Deceived" (green, 10.5%), while the inner ring, representing "Ambiguity 2", has corresponding slices labeled "Deceived" (red, 67.6%), "Partially" (yellow, 23.5%), and "Not Deceived" (green, 8.8%). The chart includes two legends, one for each ring, and percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices are visually ordered by category, with "Deceived" being the largest in both rings, followed by "Partially" and then "Not Deceived".
